name: Fluxknight - AI Sales & Lead Qualification - Multi Tenant v2.1

parameters.jsCode:
const env=$('Validate Tenant Envelope').first().json;
const executionId=$('Queue Runtime Execution').first().json.execution_id;
const schema={
 qualification_status:'hot|warm|cold|disqualified',
 score:'0-100 integer',
 stage:'new|qualified|contacted|nurturing|appointment|disqualified',
 intent:'string',
 need:'string',
 specific_interest:'string|null',
 property_interest:'string|null',
 meaningful_conversation:'boolean',
 campaign_only:'boolean',
 budget:'string|null',
 timeline:'string|null',
 location:'string|null',
 objections:['string'],
 missing_fields:['name|email|phone|company|budget|timeline|need'],
 appointment_requested:'boolean',
 requested_datetime:'ISO datetime|null',
 handoff_required:'boolean',
 handoff_reason:'string|null',
 summary:'string',
 reply:'string',
 memory_facts:[{type:'preference|fact|goal|objection',summary:'string',confidence:'0-1'}]
};
return [{json:{...env,execution_id:executionId,provider_input:{
 message:env.input.message||env.input.text||'',
 customer:env.input.customer||{},
 lead_context:env.input.lead_context||env.input,
 channel:env.channel,event_type:env.event_type,
 follow_up_detection_rules:{
   specific_interest:'Set only when the customer has shown interest in a particular property, product, service, plan or other concrete offering. Do not infer it merely because a campaign was sent.',
   property_interest:'For real-estate tenants, use the exact named estate/property/project when known.',
   meaningful_conversation:'True only when the customer actually engaged in a two-way sales conversation. A one-way campaign delivery does not count.',
   campaign_only:'True when this interaction is only a broadcast/campaign touch and the customer has not meaningfully engaged.'
 }
},output_schema:schema}}];
const persisted=$('Sync Organization Follow-Up Policy').first().json; return [{json:{...persisted,dispatch:$json}}];
